analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and one new troubleshooting table row near head line 3552 about provider crashes on a pre-release macOS 27.2 build. The supplied units (base lines 2426-3245) cover unchanged surrounding documentation on Qwen JSON constraints, tool-call parsers, MiMo native candidate, cluster registration and Flash-Next. No code, configuration, key handling, authorization, attestation, cache storage or coordinator/provider protocol behavior changes. The new row sits outside the supplied excerpt, and its patch is truncated, so I could not read its full text. I found no weakening of the stated controls relevant to T-041 (prefix-cache TTL, HMAC names, scoping), TB-002, TB-003 or TB-007. The surrounding text describes existing behavior and makes no new security claims that need threat-model updates. Remaining question: the truncated new row should be checked in full to confirm it does not recommend unsafe operator actions (for example disabling SIP or attestation). Nothing visible suggests that, so no finding is raised. Docs-only change; low risk.
